title: Design Breezily and silent aim architecture
objective: Produce an implementation-ready design for a reusable bridging-technique framework, authentic Breezily bridging, Automatic technique selection, forced-technique abort behavior, and global visible or silent-packet aim delivery for SpeedBridge Assist.
acceptance_criteria: The written design records all user-approved behavior without adding separate diagonal or staircase Breezily variants
The design distinguishes Automatic, Standard, Breezily, and future techniques through a reusable technique contract
Forced Breezily aborts safely and never falls back to another technique
Visible and silent-packet aim delivery are specified as shared infrastructure for every technique
The design maps proposed components onto the actual SpeedBridge Assist 1.1.0 classes and identifies migration boundaries
Movement, placement, packet, cleanup, testing, compatibility, and manual gameplay verification requirements are explicit
The design is self-reviewed for placeholders, contradictions, scope drift, and ambiguous requirements
